statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog will add at least one entry for a Citrix NetScaler product, with a date-added value between 2026-09-28 and 2026-10-11.
resolution: True if the CISA KEV catalog (cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog) lists a NetScaler-related CVE with dateAdded between 2026-09-28 and 2026-10-11 inclusive; false otherwise.
failure_condition: No CISA KEV catalog entry naming a NetScaler product carries a date-added value inside the window.

statement: Microsoft will document a resumed rollout or a replacement fix for the KB5002907 Office license-deactivation issue between 2026-09-28 and 2026-10-18.
resolution: True if Microsoft's Release Health dashboard or a support.microsoft.com KB article confirms KB5002907, or its direct successor patch, is fixed and redistributed inside the window; false otherwise.
failure_condition: Microsoft has not documented a fix or resumed rollout for the KB5002907 issue by the deadline.

statement: The S&P 500 will close below 7,600 (Reference: 7,743.41 at the 26 Sep 2026 close, per the packet) on at least one trading day between 2026-09-28 and 2026-10-16.
resolution: True if any official S&P 500 closing print reported by a major index provider or wire service falls below 7,600.00 on a trading day in the window; false otherwise.
failure_condition: No trading-day close below 7,600 occurs in the window.

statement: The US 10-Year Treasury yield will close at or above 5.30 percent (Reference: 5.18 percent on 2026-09-27, per the packet) on at least one day between 2026-09-28 and 2026-10-09.
resolution: True if the Treasury daily par yield curve or FRED series DGS10 shows a close at or above 5.30 percent on any date in the window; false otherwise.
failure_condition: DGS10 never closes at or above 5.30 percent on any date in the window.

statement: A lapse in federal appropriations will force at least one US federal department to furlough staff or suspend non-excepted operations between 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-08.
resolution: True if OMB, OPM, or two of Reuters, AP, and Politico report a funding lapse causing furloughs or suspended operations at a federal department starting in the window; false otherwise.
failure_condition: Congress and the President enact full-year or stopgap appropriations before the deadline, so no department loses funding in the window.

statement: Vivek Ramaswamy will win the 2026 Ohio gubernatorial general election held on 2026-11-03.
resolution: True if the Ohio Secretary of State certified result or an AP race call names Ramaswamy the winner by the deadline; false if Acton wins or the race is uncalled.
failure_condition: Amy Acton is certified or called the winner, or the race remains uncalled at the deadline.

statement: No candidate will win an outright majority in Brazil's first-round presidential election on 2026-10-04, forcing an October 25 runoff.
resolution: True if Brazil's Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE) results portal shows no candidate above 50 percent of valid votes and schedules the runoff; false if one candidate exceeds 50 percent.
failure_condition: A single candidate is certified with more than 50 percent of valid first-round votes.

statement: The United States and Iran will not publicly announce a signed or explicitly agreed arrangement reopening the Strait of Hormuz to normal commercial shipping between 2026-09-28 and 2026-10-25.
resolution: True unless two of Reuters, AP, and Al Jazeera report a named, explicit US-Iran arrangement reopening Hormuz shipping announced in the window; then false.
failure_condition: The United States and Iran publicly announce a named agreement reopening Hormuz shipping inside the window.

statement: South African Police Service will announce at least one arrest connected to either of the two mass shootings reported on 2026-09-27 in Johannesburg and Cape Town, between 2026-09-28 and 2026-10-12.
resolution: True if SAPS, News24, or Reuters reports a named arrest tied to either shooting, dated inside the window; false otherwise.
failure_condition: No SAPS-confirmed arrest tied to either shooting is reported by the deadline.

statement: USGS will catalog at least one aftershock of magnitude 5.0 or greater within 200 km of the 2026-09-26 M6.6 New Caledonia mainshock (event id us6000txpi), occurring between 2026-09-28 and 2026-10-11.
resolution: True if USGS ComCat lists a magnitude 5.0 or greater event within 200 km of the us6000txpi epicenter with an origin time inside the window; false otherwise.
failure_condition: USGS catalogs no magnitude 5.0 or greater event within 200 km of the epicenter inside the window.
